characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.summary: Just released from Leonida Penitentiary and determined that every move from here on is a smart one.
body: Lucia learned to fight from her father, and life has been coming at her swinging ever since. Fighting for her family is what put her inside Leonida Penitentiary, and luck is what got her out.
She wants the good life her mother has dreamed about since their days in Liberty City, and she is done leaving it to chance. A life with Jason could be her way out.
||GTA BOOM's story guide says the game opens with a prologue played as Lucia, then switches to Jason in the Leonida Keys.||
||PowerPyx's walkthrough lists a Chapter 1 mission called "Coming Home" (Lucia's release). Before it come optional errands such as buying Lucia flowers, a necklace and clothes.||
||GTABase lists her safehouses as the Leonida Keys Safehouse, the Bayside Safehouse and the Starlet Motel Safehouse, and names her mother as Mia Caminos.||

characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.summary: A former soldier raised among grifters and crooks, now working for drug runners in the Leonida Keys.
body: Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. A spell in the Army was meant to straighten out a rough adolescence; instead he ended up in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners.
He wants an easy life, but things keep getting harder. Meeting Lucia might be the best thing that ever happened to him, or the worst.
||VGC's review says the story follows Jason trying to build a semi-straight life with Lucia, and that the missions begin in the Leonida Keys.||
||VGC's guide to Jason's house says Jason can fix four projects at his home after the first mission, Gone Fishing. Skipping them lowers Lucia's starting relationship meter when she returns.||
||GTABase lists his vehicles as a turquoise Ganado '70 and a Tulip '72.||
ties: Lives rent-free on Brian Heder's property

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.summary: Jason's friend, most at ease at home with a few beers and the Coast Guard radio chatter turned up.
body: Cal is Jason's friend and another of Brian Heder's associates. He is happily paranoid, spending his time at home listening in on Coast Guard traffic.
Jason has bigger plans. Cal would rather stay exactly where he is.
||Kotaku's review describes an early mission in which Jason and Cal clean a living room, move a TV and play video games together.||
||GTA BOOM's story guide says Cal is with Jason in the first mission, Gone Fishing. He is also the contact for Unwanted Attention and sends the message that starts Feng Shui.||
||PowerPyx lists a Cal side mission called Catch a Bigger Fish, and GTABase lists his occupation as conspiracy theorist and boatyard worker.||

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.summary: A Vice City legend who turned street reputation into real estate, a strip club and a recording studio.
body: Boobie is one of the few who made the jump from the street to an empire of property, nightlife and a studio. He is all smiles until it is time to talk business.
What he cares about most is Only Raw Records, the label he runs with Dre'Quan Priest. All it needs now is a hit.
Rockstar heads his profile with the line "It's all about heart — the Jack of Hearts." The page does not say what the Jack of Hearts is.
||GTABase lists Boobie's occupation as businessman and owner of the Jack of Hearts. GTA BOOM says the Jack of Hearts is his strip club, and that it helps fund the record studio.||
||PowerPyx's walkthrough places his mission Boobie Time in Chapter 3, played as Jason, and lists him in its character index as "Boobie (Mr. Ike)".||
ties: Runs Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest
Backs the label Real Dimez are signed to

characters.name: Dre'Quan Priest
characters.summary: More hustler than gangster. Dealing paid the bills, but music was always the real plan.
body: Dre'Quan sold on the street to get by, with his eye on the music industry the whole time. He books the acts at Boobie Ike's club and runs Only Raw Records alongside him.
Signing Real Dimez could be the break that moves him beyond club bookings.
||GTA BOOM's story guide says Jason meets Dre'Quan at the Jack of Hearts studio to start the Chapter 3 mission Dealer's Choice.||
||PowerPyx lists his missions as Dealer's Choice and Ride or Die in Chapter 3 and Watch It and Fresh Evidence in Chapter 4, all played as Jason.||
||GTA BOOM's Prepare for Vice City walkthrough says Dre'Quan arranges a place for Jason and Lucia to stay when they move to Vice City.||
ties: Runs Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike

characters.name: Real Dimez
characters.summary: Two friends since high school who went from shaking down dealers to rap tracks and a nonstop social feed.
body: Bae-Luxe and Roxy have been friends since school. They turned their time squeezing local dealers into rap tracks and a relentless social media presence.
An early hit with local rapper DWNPLY took them up; five years and a lot of trouble later they are signed to Only Raw Records and hoping for a second one.
||PowerPyx's walkthrough lists the Chapter 3 mission Top Billing (Watch the Real Dimez). Its character index lists the duo as "Bae-Luxe, Roxy (Dimez)".||
ties: Signed to Only Raw Records by Dre'Quan Priest

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.summary: A veteran bank robber with confidence, charm and cunning, always looking for talent willing to take the big risks.
body: Raul has the confidence, charm and cunning of someone who has been robbing banks for a long time, and he is always recruiting.
His recklessness raises the stakes with every score. Sooner or later his crew will have to double down or walk away.
||PowerPyx's walkthrough introduces Raul in Chapter 3 through missions including Car Service, First Impressions, Crosstown Traffic and Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew).||
||PowerPyx lists a Chapter 3 heist arc that starts with scoping out the Sinfrontera National Bank and ends in The Cartel Heist.||

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.summary: An old-school drug runner from the golden age of Keys smuggling, still moving product through his boat yard.
body: Brian has been around long enough to let other people do his dirty work. He still runs product through the boat yard he keeps with his third wife, Lori.
He lets Jason stay rent-free at one of his properties, on the understanding that Jason helps out with local shakedowns.
||GTABase says Brian runs Brian's Boat Works & Marina and is Jason's landlord at the Leonida Keys Safehouse.||
||PowerPyx's walkthrough ties him to Chapter 1 missions including Lab Fees (Collect Brian's Rent), Hey Arnold!, Down to Earth and Swamped. It also lists Meet the Heders, with Lori, in Chapter 3.||
||GTA BOOM's Swamped walkthrough says that mission starts at Brian's marina.||
ties: Landlord and employer of Jason Duval

locations.name: Vice City
locations.summary: The crowded heart of Leonida, and the series' first return to its Miami stand-in since 2002.
body: Rockstar's own description covers the pastel art deco hotels and white sands of Ocean Beach, the bakeries of Little Cuba, the bootleg brands of the Tisha-Wocka flea market and VC Port, billed as the cruise ship capital of the world.
Other districts named in official material are La Perle, Stockyard, Tequesta and Vice Beach. Rockstar has not published a full district list.

The GTA Wiki's fan-compiled list adds Belville, Crosstown, Downtown, Ekanfinaka, Peacock Bay, Rockridge and Southside. It treats Vice Beach, with Ocean Beach and Washington Beach, as a neighbouring city across the bay, and records two venues, Fleeca Field and Sahara Arena. These are community readings of the trailers and screenshots, not a list from Rockstar.
||Kotaku's review says Vice City has over 600 stores, plus gyms, gun ranges, golf courses, zoos, and buses and trains that run to schedules.||

||VGC's review says Vice City shows as a distant skyline early on and is not locked off. PowerPyx's walkthrough has Jason and Lucia move there at the end of Chapter 2, and Chapter 3 opens with the mission Welcome to Vice City.||
||PowerPyx names a Chapter 4 mission Ocean Beach, and VGC's Ultimate Edition guide mentions a dock at Washington Beach.||

locations.name: Leonida Keys
locations.summary: The island chain south of Vice City: easy living on some of the most beautiful and dangerous water around. Jason's story starts here.
body: Life in the Keys is not flashy, but it is easy. Official images show divers over coral, party boats, jet skis and a crowded beach bar.
It is also smuggling country. Brian Heder runs his operation from a boat yard here, and Jason works for the local drug runners.

Fans have picked out four island names so far: Key Lento, East Key, Catalan Key and Goose Key. A Leonida Keys road sign appears in the Launch Trailer. The island names are community readings recorded by the GTA Wiki, not a list from Rockstar.
||GTA BOOM's story guide says Jason's part of the story starts in the Leonida Keys and that early jobs take place there, including in Key Lento.||
||GTA BOOM's Tourist Trap walkthrough says that Chapter 1 mission begins in Key Lento.||
||GTA BOOM's Rusty Anchor page places that bar in the Keys.||

locations.name: Grassrivers
locations.summary: Leonida's vast wetlands, where you never quite know what is under the surface.
body: Grassrivers is swamp, mangroves and open shallow water between the city and the interior. The alligators are the famous attraction, though Rockstar hints at deadlier predators and stranger finds.
Official images show airboats, alligators and a police helicopter chasing a pickup through the swamp.

The GTA Wiki lists Watson Bay as the one town in the wetlands, and suggests the name nods to The Everglades: River of Grass, the 1947 book by Marjory Stoneman Douglas. Both are community notes, not statements from Rockstar.
||GTA BOOM's Tourist Trap walkthrough includes a visit to the Grassrivers visitor center.||
||Kotaku's review describes a large swamp full of creatures, including a giant snake.||
||GTA BOOM's walkthrough of Swamped, a Chapter 1 mission from Brian, says it ends in a chase on land, in the air and on the water, using airboats.||

locations.name: Port Gellhorn
locations.basedOn: Florida's faded Gulf Coast resort towns
locations.summary: A former holiday hotspot that lost its tourists and found a rougher economy to replace them.
body: Port Gellhorn used to be the centre of Leonida's tourist trade. What is left is cheap motels, shut-down attractions and empty strip malls.
The new economy runs on rougher goods, and the local transport of choice is a dirt bike.
||GTA BOOM's guides say Chapter 2 begins at the Starlet Motel and ends with Jason and Lucia leaving Port Gellhorn for Vice City. Its Port Gellhorn page places the Starlet Motel in the town.||
||PowerPyx's trophy guide places Moses's car deliveries and the Kingpin Bowling robbery in Port Gellhorn.||

locations.name: Ambrosia
locations.summary: Inland Leonida, where the Allied Crystal sugar refinery supplies the jobs and a biker gang supplies the rest.
body: Ambrosia is built around the state's sugar industry, a long way from the coast. The Allied Crystal refinery provides the work.
By Rockstar's account, the local biker gang provides almost everything else.
||PowerPyx's trophy guide mentions a train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.||

locations.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
locations.basedOn: Florida's state forests and hill country
locations.summary: Forest, high ground and backwoods against the northern border: the closest Leonida gets to wilderness.
body: Mount Kalaga is a national landmark at the top of the map, pitched for its hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
The backwoods around it are home to people who want to live well away from the government. Official images show dirt bikes, an ATV, hunters, a cougar stalking deer and a kayaker.
||VGC's review says Leonida includes countryside, national parks, small towns, industrial zones and ocean depths. It does not name Mount Kalaga.||

vehicles.name: Classic Cars
vehicles.summary: Old American metal, restored and rebuilt. Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots show the Vapid Ganado Retro Build, a low-riding pickup.
body: The Vapid Ganado Retro Build is named and pictured in Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots. Its in-game class and performance have not been published.
||VGC's Ultimate Edition guide says the Ganado Retro Build unlocks in Chapter 1 after the mission Just a Scratch.||
||GTABase lists Jason's own vehicles as a Ganado '70 and a Tulip '72.||

vehicles.name: Sports Cars
vehicles.summary: Low, wide and fast. Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots show the '95 Grotti Cheetah.
body: The '95 Grotti Cheetah is named and pictured in Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots. Its in-game class and performance have not been published.
||VGC's Ultimate Edition guide says the '95 Grotti Cheetah unlocks in Chapter 5, at the safehouse.||

vehicles.name: Boats
vehicles.summary: From Brian Heder's boat yard to the party boats of the Keys, Leonida lives on the water.
body: Official images of the Leonida Keys show a raft of party boats. Brian Heder moves product through a boat yard there.
||Kotaku's review lists boats and jet skis among the vehicles you can drive.||
||VGC's Ultimate Edition guide says the Shitzu Squalo boat unlocks in Chapter 4 at the Washington Beach dock.||
||GTABase calls Brian's business Brian's Boat Works & Marina.||

vehicles.name: Airboats
vehicles.summary: Flat-bottomed and fan-driven, the way across Grassrivers.
body: Airboats appear in Rockstar's Grassrivers images, and airboating was among the activities in the Extended Look.
||Kotaku's review lists airboats among the vehicles you can drive.||
||GTA BOOM's Swamped walkthrough says that Chapter 1 mission uses airboats in its chase on the water.||

vehicles.name: Pickups, Dirt Bikes and ATVs
vehicles.summary: Mud-ready machines for the backwoods, from Port Gellhorn to Mount Kalaga.
body: Official images show dirt bikes and an ATV in the mud at Mount Kalaga and a pickup being chased through Grassrivers. Rockstar's Port Gellhorn text tells you to jump on a dirt bike.
||Kotaku's review lists dirt bikes and semi-trucks among the vehicles you can drive.||
||GTA BOOM's Swamped walkthrough says the mission uses Jason's truck, an ATV and a red truck.||

vehicles.name: '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy
vehicles.summary: An off-road buggy included with the Ultimate Edition, pitched for the backwoods of Mount Kalaga.
body: Rockstar's Ultimate Edition description presents it as a Mud Club vehicle with strong off-road handling.
It can be kept at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay, which Rockstar says has a weapon locker and somewhere to drop off stolen goods for fencing.
||VGC's Ultimate Edition guide says the '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy unlocks in Chapter 2 when you finish Wyman's side mission, in which you help him start his car in the motel parking lot.||
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 5.0, Acceleration 6.1, Asphalt handling 3.5, Off-road handling 6.7, Strength 3.0, as read by GTABase only so far.

facts.where: Ultimate Edition: Chapter 2: collect from the Paradise garage in Watson Bay, Mariana County, and get in to register it; its liveries are applied at any Pay 'n' Spray (Push Square UE guide).
facts.customise: Specialist tag "Off-Road" (GTABase) matches the Off-Road specialty shop: Wasteland Off-Road or One-Eyed Willie's Auto Shop (Ultimate Edition)
facts.menu_text: Classic muscle car, converted for off-roading with lifted suspension.

vehicles.name: Planes and Helicopters
vehicles.summary: Seaplanes over the Keys and helicopters over everything.
body: Official images show a seaplane over the Leonida Keys, a police helicopter over Grassrivers and a news helicopter over Mount Kalaga.
||Kotaku's review lists planes and helicopters among the vehicles you can drive.||
||GTA BOOM's Swamped walkthrough says the mission uses a Sea Sparrow helicopter. PowerPyx's trophy guide has a trophy for stealing a passenger plane at VCIA.||

vehicles.name: Jet Skis and Kayaks
vehicles.summary: Small craft for the Keys and the rivers of the north.
body: Jet skis and kayaking were both shown in the Extended Look. Official images show jet skis in the Keys and a kayaker at Mount Kalaga.
||Kotaku's review lists jet skis among the vehicles you can drive.||

gameplay.name: Switching between Jason and Lucia
gameplay.summary: ||Free switching between Jason and Lucia opens in Chapter 2. You hold right on the d-pad and press R1 (RB on Xbox).||
body: ||PowerPyx says you mostly play as Jason in Chapter 1, and free switching unlocks in Chapter 2 after the main mission Coffee Break.||
||GamesRadar+ says you hold right on the d-pad and press R1 (RB on Xbox) to switch, and a darkened portrait means your partner is busy for now.||
||VGC says a lead is greyed out only for an in-game reason, such as being on another mission. PowerPyx says the other lead can be greyed out while you are at home.||
||Kotaku's review says the lead you are not playing keeps their own life. Switching to Lucia took a few seconds, and Kotaku found the leads watching TV, chatting to people or driving.||
||OutputLag says Jason and Lucia each have their own Criminal Profile and their own Strength, Cardio and Focus stats.||

gameplay.name: Six-star wanted level
gameplay.summary: ||The wanted meter has six stars, and police track your outfit, appearance, vehicle, weapon and partner as separate clues.||
body: ||OutputLag says there are six stars. Icons under them show each thing the police know, such as your outfit, appearance, vehicle, visible weapon or partner.||
||OutputLag says you lose the cops by breaking line of sight, leaving the search area and then changing what they know. It says a respray clears the vehicle clue.||
||PC Gamer says six stars takes mass destruction, such as stealing a tank from the military base. It says that at six stars you can no longer lose your wanted level.||
||OutputLag says higher stars bring helicopters, spike strips and K9 units. GTABase says K9 units track you relentlessly.||
||GTABase says CCTV footage can be destroyed on site, but footage recorded by cloud CCTV cannot.||

gameplay.name: Combat
gameplay.summary: ||Combat leans on manual aiming. Focus slow motion lets you wound enemies in the limbs instead of killing them.||
body: ||Kotaku's review says combat moves away from GTA V's auto-aim and plays more like Max Payne 3, with manual aiming and headshots or kneecap shots.||
||PC Gamer says Focus highlights elbows, knees, hands and shoulders, so you can incapacitate enemies instead of killing them.||
||GTABase says you press L3 and R3 together for Focus. It says melee drains stamina, and a counter must be timed just before an incoming attack.||
||GTABase says R1 (RB on Xbox) takes cover, and that sustained fire reduces accuracy.||

gameplay.name: Stealing cars
gameplay.summary: ||Cars can be locked, alarmed, keyless or tracked. The WAiNK phone app scans a car first, and better cars need a slim jim or a key cloner.||
body: ||PC Gamer says the Waink It app arrives in the Chapter 1 mission Unwanted Attention. It shows a car's make, locks, alarm, keyless status, trackers, condition, sale value and registration cost.||
||PC Gamer says the Chapter 2 mission Moses gives you the slim jim, which opens locks quietly. It says the key cloner comes in Chapter 3 and also starts keyless cars, which cannot be hotwired.||
||GTABase says you hotwire a car by bringing both sticks together to fill the semi-circles, and that smashing a window can set off an alarm.||
||PC Gamer says many drivers fight back when pulled out, so you must hammer a button. It says an advanced tracker beeps when you slow down and then gives your location to the police.||
||PC Gamer says a standard tracker only stops you modifying the car until you register it at a Pay 'n' Spray.||

gameplay.name: Robberies
gameplay.summary: ||Almost any shop can be robbed. A safe code from staff or a job card beats blowing the safe, which destroys part of the cash.||
body: ||OutputLag says almost any shop can be robbed, including ones not shown on the map, and that a clerk may give you the safe code.||
||OutputLag says explosives open a safe without the code but destroy part of the cash. It says clerks and shoppers can pull guns on you.||
||OutputLag says to destroy the security footage in the back room and leave by the back exit if there is one. GTABase says footage from cloud CCTV cannot be destroyed.||
||GamesRadar+ says each lead can carry two stash bags. GTA BOOM found that a vehicle's storage limits how much you take away.||
||OutputLag says Yasmani's jewelry job cards list the safe code, and that bank map cards show the take before you go in.||

activities.name: Racing
activities.summary: ||There are 40 unique races, from circuit tracks to Yago's street races and the Thrillbilly Mud Club's dirt tracks.||
body: ||PowerPyx says there are 40 unique races, and each costs an entry fee and a car rental.||
||PowerPyx says Vice City street races open in Chapter 3 through Dre'Quan and Yago, and the Thrillbilly Mud Club runs dirt and oval races.||
||OutputLag says Gellhorn Raceway has stock cars, supercars, bikes, rallycross and a drag strip, and Top Fun drone races run at 14 locations.||
||GTABase says L3 is the horn and nitrous button.||

activities.name: Water sports
activities.summary: ||Jet skis, scuba diving for shipwreck treasure and an Ultimate Edition kayak are all in the game.||
body: ||OutputLag says jet skis can be taken from riders all over the Keys, and Jason's boat waits at his dock.||
||OutputLag says treasure diving opens after Kenton's mission Island Dreams, with scuba gear on the boat.||
||OutputLag says your oxygen shows as a bar at the top left while diving.||
||OutputLag says the Crest Kayak is an Ultimate Edition item, and it is only available in Chapter 1.||

activities.name: Sports and leisure
activities.summary: ||Pool, mini golf, basketball, gyms, shooting ranges, parachuting and nightclubs are all in the game.||
body: ||OutputLag lists pool, golf, shooting ranges, races, drone races, gym workouts, basketball, fishing and hunting as activities.||
||OutputLag says golf is mini golf, but PC Gamer says there are full golf courses too.||
||PC Gamer says you can buy a parachute at Ammu-Nation, and some skyscraper roofs have parachutes.||
||PC Gamer says you can hit nightclubs and dance with your partner.||
||OutputLag says no playable casino or gambling has been found.||

activities.name: Hunting, fishing and off-roading
activities.summary: ||Fishing is catch and release and trains Focus, while hunting pays through Jason's old military friend Bret.||
body: ||OutputLag says free-roam fishing is catch and release, and the only option after a catch is to throw the fish back.||
||GTABase says you cannot keep fish or sell them to a shop, and that better lures are sold at Ammu-Nation stores with fishing gear.||
||OutputLag says every fish you land raises Focus, and PC Gamer says Jason and Cal keep up a fishing rivalry.||
||PC Gamer says hunting jobs for Jason's old military friend Bret begin in Lummox County in Chapter 2, and Bret buys animals straight out of your trunk.||
||PC Gamer says GTA 6 has legendary animals, and Bret paid it $2,500 for a large boar.||

activities.name: Everyday life
activities.summary: ||You can pet dogs and cats, watch TV, shop in over 600 stores and eat while walking.||
body: ||Kotaku says you can pet dogs and cats, and it boosts Focus and your Criminal Profile.||
||Kotaku's review says there are over 600 stores, and all of them are open 24 hours.||
||Kotaku's review says the TV shows animated series and other shows.||
||Kotaku says you can eat and drink while moving, shooting and driving.||
||PC Gamer says you can push cars, lean on rails and sit on docks.||

wildlife.name: Deer
wildlife.summary: Seen at a stream in Mount Kalaga National Park in an official image.
body: ||PowerPyx's walkthrough lists Bret Vogel's Jason-only side quest Veteran Hunted. Its trophy guide has a trophy, Fair Game, for hunting a unique animal for Bret.||
||Kotaku's review says animals can be hunted for money. PowerPyx's trophy guide says 100% completion needs 100 of 255 animals studied.||

wildlife.name: Sea turtles
wildlife.summary: An official Leonida Keys image shows divers among coral with a sea turtle.
body: ||PowerPyx's trophy guide counts underwater discoveries, and studying 100 of 255 animals, toward 100% completion. Its walkthrough lists Kenton's dive-site side quest.||

wildlife.name: Dogs
wildlife.summary: Dogs can be petted, as shown in the Extended Look.
body: ||GTA BOOM says you can pet or scold dogs.||
||GTA BOOM's Motel Tiger guide warns of a loose dog near the Manatee Motel that can knock the player down.||

businesses.name: Only Raw Records
businesses.summary: The Vice City record label run by Boobie Ike and Dre'Quan Priest. Real Dimez are signed to it.
body: ||GTA BOOM's story guide says Jason meets Dre'Quan at the Jack of Hearts studio. GTA BOOM's label page says the studio is paid for by Boobie's Jack of Hearts strip club.||
||PowerPyx's walkthrough lists the Chapter 3 mission Top Billing (Watch the Real Dimez).||

businesses.name: Allied Crystal sugar refinery
businesses.summary: Ambrosia's sugar refinery and the source of the town's jobs.

businesses.name: Tisha-Wocka flea market
businesses.summary: A flea market known, in Rockstar's words, for its bootleg brands.

businesses.name: Brian Heder's boat yard
businesses.summary: The Keys boat yard Brian runs with his wife Lori, and the front for his smuggling.
body: ||GTABase names the business Brian's Boat Works & Marina.||
||GTA BOOM's Swamped walkthrough says that Chapter 1 mission starts at Brian's marina.||

businesses.name: Fleeca bank
businesses.summary: A Fleeca bank is named in the captions of Rockstar's launch screenshot gallery.

businesses.name: The Rusty Anchor
businesses.summary: A bar named in the captions of Rockstar's launch screenshot gallery.
body: ||GTA BOOM's page places the Rusty Anchor in the Leonida Keys, with a dance floor and a stage. It lists GTA BOOM's Day Release and Swamped walkthroughs as coverage of the bar.||

businesses.name: Delights Cabaret
businesses.summary: A cabaret named in the captions of Rockstar's launch screenshot gallery.
body: GameSpot (November 19) counts three working strip clubs and calls Delights Cabaret the only one outside Vice City, a more middle-class club than the downtown ones.
GameSpot puts it on the Port Gellhorn highway strip in western Kelly County and says it is owned by ||Frankie||.

factions.name: Raul Bautista's crew
factions.summary: The bank robbery crew Raul leads. Rockstar has not named anyone else in it.
body: ||PowerPyx's walkthrough lists a Chapter 3 mission called Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), followed by heist preparation missions that end in The Cartel Heist.||

factions.name: Ambrosia biker gang
factions.summary: An unnamed biker gang that, by Rockstar's account, runs almost everything in Ambrosia the refinery does not.
body: ||GTA BOOM identifies the bikers riding in Ambrosia in Rockstar's images as the Final Chapter MC, going by the club name and the Ambrosia chapter shown on their patches.||

factions.name: Keys drug runners
factions.summary: The smuggling trade of the Leonida Keys, where Jason works and Brian Heder is the old guard.
body: ||GTA BOOM's Swamped walkthrough says Brian sends Jason to a meeting with a group called the Kingfishers, which turns into a fight through their camp.||
||PowerPyx's walkthrough lists Chapter 1 jobs including Lab Fees (Collect Brian's Rent), Clean Up After Donnie and Donnie's Lost Drugs.||

music.name: Original score by Justice
music.summary: The electronic duo Justice composed the game's score. A 30-track album is due on December 11, 2026.
body: Singles so far are "Flower in a Hurricane" and "Pusher". The Launch Trailer is set to new music from the duo.
Justice are the French duo Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay. Rockstar calls the score adaptive: it changes with how you play.
"Flower in a Hurricane" features Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. "Pusher" features Gesaffelstein.
The album comes to streaming services, CD and vinyl. Rockstar's shop lists a limited triple crystal clear vinyl and a double CD.
Apple Music's pre-release listing shows 50 tracks, dated December 11, 2026. Rockstar says the album has 30 tracks plus a number of digital bonus tracks.
Only two titles are shown so far: Pusher is track 18 and Flower In A Hurricane is track 36. The other 48 are untitled placeholders.
Apple Music credits the release to Take-Two Interactive Software under exclusive licence to Ed Banger Records and Because Music.
||Kotaku's review says the score is by Justice and mixes electronic dance music, '80s funk and rock guitars.||
||uDiscover Music reported on launch day that Justice's 30-track Original Score is due on December 11, on triple vinyl and on two CDs.||

music.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album
music.summary: The official soundtrack album: 34 original tracks made with Atlantic Records, out with the game on November 19, 2026.
body: Rockstar's music page lists ten singles: "That's It" by Yung Lean (featuring Future and Metro Boomin); "RHYNO" by Travis Scott; "Sexy Magic" by CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Etienne de Crécy; "Flower in a Hurricane" by Justice; "Last Thing You Need" by Morgan Wallen; "Suzuki" by Fuerza Regida; "Macacoa 2000" by Rauw Alejandro; "Don't Chart" by Cardi B; "Blood In Your Eyes" by Tove Lo; and "Bright Lights, Big City" by Keith Richards.
Rockstar's shop lists the album on an exclusive vinyl and a standard vinyl.
Apple Music now lists all 34 tracks; the full running order is in the entry Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album track list.

Tracks not among the ten singles include Go Easy by Dua Lipa, Crazy For You by Lana Del Rey, Power Trip by JENNIE, Fast Emotion by Zara Larsson, Sweet Like Candy by Camila Cabello and Bigger by Burna Boy.
Apple Music's New Zealand store dates the album November 20, 2026, one day after the date on Rockstar's music page.
||uDiscover Music reported on launch day that Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album has 34 tracks and came out on November 19, 2026, the same day as the game.||

music.name: Radio stations and podcasts
music.summary: Rockstar has named six radio stations and confirmed on-demand podcasts, plus radio on foot through headphones.
body: The six are Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics. Each has its own entry in this category, with its genre and hosts.
Rockstar's music page also mentions stations for classic rock and talk radio, without naming them, and says the game has the series' widest selection of radio and podcasts.

With the game out, GameSpot and CULTR each count 22 stations: the six Rockstar named plus Emotion 98.3, Vice City FM, V-Rock, Stockyard FM, VCRR, Honey FM, Radio La Ola, Radio On-U, Gloriana Blues Radio, Leonida Jazz Radio, Symphony FM, Worldwide FM, CircoLoco Records Radio, Kaleidoscope FM, and the talk stations WKTT and The Wipe.
The Big Lead says 23, though its own table has 22 rows, counting the unlockable Vault Radio and leaving out CircoLoco Records Radio. Adding The Vault Radio to GameSpot's 22 also gives 23.
GameSpot calls it the most stations in any Grand Theft Auto game.
None of the three outlets names an individual podcast.
||VGC's launch-day guide lists 22 stations, including the talk stations The Wipe and WKTT. KeenGamer counts 23, adding The Vault Radio.||
||VGC's podcast guide names five podcast series and says you can listen in cars, on a portable radio or through headphones.||

music.name: Trailer 1 song
music.summary: The reveal trailer was set to Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road".
body: ||uDiscover Music's launch-day article confirms that the first trailer was set to "Love Is a Long Road", from Tom Petty's 1989 album Full Moon Fever.||

editions.name: Standard Edition
editions.summary: The base game on PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S.
body: Pre-orders, and copies bought up to November 19, 2026, included the Vintage Vice City Pack: the '55 Vapid Stanier with a garage by Ocean Beach, outfits and hairstyles for Jason and Lucia, and a weapon pattern.
A digital pre-order on either console included one month of GTA+. PlayStation's page adds that it can be claimed until March 31, 2027 and renews as a paid subscription unless cancelled.
The boxed version holds a download code and no disc. The Vintage Vice City Pack came with pre-orders and with purchases made before November 20, 2026.
||Al Jazeera reported that the game launched on November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series consoles. The report does not mention a PC version.||

editions.name: Ultimate Edition
editions.summary: The game plus an exclusive collection of items tied to Jason and Lucia's story.
body: Rockstar lists vehicles (among them the '95 Grotti Cheetah, '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy and Shitzu Squalo), the Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers, personalized pistols, shops that open only with this edition (six, by VGC's launch guide: Rideout Customs, Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305, Electric Fang Tattoo Parlor, One-Eyed Willie's and the PTT Youngin$ illegal goods store), a gang raid and a car-collecting commission. Each has its own entry.

PlayStation's page groups the extras as vehicles and garages, weapons, looks, and a special commission and customs. Two of Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshot sets are titled "Vice City Style" and "Goodtime Gear".

The PlayStation Store also lists an Ultimate Edition Upgrade as a separate add-on. A digital pre-order on either console included one month of GTA+. PlayStation's page adds that it can be claimed until March 31, 2027 and renews as a paid subscription unless cancelled.
There is no boxed Ultimate Edition. Standard Edition owners, boxed or digital, can buy the Ultimate Edition Upgrade from the PlayStation or Microsoft store once their copy is redeemed.

||VGC says there is no separate claim step: the game sends a notice as each Ultimate Edition item unlocks. The first arrive in Chapter 1, such as the Ganado Retro Build after Just a Scratch, and the '95 Grotti Cheetah comes last, in Chapter 5.||
||VGC adds that the Ultimate Edition bonuses can also be bought separately.||

news.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival
news.summary: A live launch event at Mana Wynwood in Miami, with two stages of artists from the game and its soundtrack.
body: Announced by Rockstar on November 9, presented with PlayStation and produced by the creators of III Points. The announced performers include Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black and Sofaygo (as Cactus Jack), Cardi B, Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso, Justice (DJ set), Metro Boomin and Tainy.
Tickets went through a pre-sale lottery that closed on November 10, limited to two per code.

news.name: Rockstar Support adds its first in-game help articles
news.summary: Rockstar's support site added launch articles on BuckMe account limits, the settings menu and console error codes.
body: Cannot put any more money in my BuckMe account in Grand Theft Auto VI (last updated November 19): limits on the BuckMe Checking and Family Savings accounts rise as the main story progresses, and payments held up by a full Checking account go through once it is upgraded.

How to change Grand Theft Auto VI settings (November 18): Settings is in the Pause Menu, with the categories Control Scheme, Controller, Gameplay, Display, UI, Camera, Audio and Account, and Restore All or Restore Default options.
Grand Theft Auto VI Error Troubleshooting (November 18): it points to PlayStation's and Xbox's own error-code pages.

Grand Theft Auto VI Platforms, Editions, and Versions was updated on November 18. It says the game will be available through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles using Xbox Series S graphics settings, and fully supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox.
No known-issues list or title update notes had been posted when the site was read.

news.name: Launch day
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI releases on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar's support site gives the time as midnight local time in every region.
body: New Zealand reached midnight first, at 11:00 UTC on November 18, and the release follows the clock west from there.

news.name: Australia's broadband network sets a traffic record on launch night
news.summary: ABC News reports Australia's National Broadband Network moved a record 36.54 terabits per second on the night of the launch.
body: An NBN spokesperson told ABC News that traffic on the night of November 18 and early November 19 peaked at 36.54 terabits per second, about 20 percent above normal and above the record set on November 12.
ABC News reports the game went live in Australia just after midnight AEDT and that some fans set their consoles to New Zealand time to start hours early.
ABC News also quotes a former Good Game Spawn Point host, Angharad Yeo, saying Rockstar had reportedly taken about US$1.5 billion in pre-sales; that is a reported figure, not one from Take-Two.

news.name: Rockstar gives the resolution on each console
news.summary: In a statement reported by VGC, Rockstar says PlayStation 5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X start from 1440p and output 4K, while Xbox Series S starts from 720p and outputs 1080p.
body: VGC reports a joint statement given to Wccftech by Rockstar's senior vice president of technology Jonathon Ashcroft, technical director Chris Oat and technology production director Marc Chambers.

As VGC quotes it, the statement says PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X upscale a base resolution of 1440p to 4K with Rockstar's own TAA, PlayStation 5 Pro uses PSSR2 to upscale 1440p to 4K, and Xbox Series S upscales 720p to 1080p with AMD FSR.
The statement says the team decided early on to target 30 frames per second on this generation of consoles and that input latency is much improved over Grand Theft Auto V and Red Dead Redemption 2.
VGC's headline calls the Series S upscaler FSR 4.1, while the quoted statement says FSR Upscaling 4. VGC says it seems to be the first Series S game to use the new AMD upscaling.

VGC also cites Digital Foundry's view that the Series S version looks close in broad strokes to Series X but has frame-rate problems, with Digital Foundry advising players to use other consoles for now.

news.name: Rockstar explains why darts and bowling are missing
news.summary: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson told VGC the team left out darts because it could not make it good enough in the time it had.
body: Nelson told VGC that even Rockstar does not have unlimited money or time, and that darts was one activity the team did not get to.

He said that since Red Dead Redemption 2, Rockstar treats minigames as activities that must feel like an extension of the game's mechanics, giving pool with proper physics, weightlifting and basketball shooting as examples.
VGC notes darts was in the previous two Grand Theft Auto games and GTA Online, and bowling in Grand Theft Auto IV.

news.name: Sony and Microsoft shares rise with the launch
news.summary: Stocktwits reports Sony closed nearly 3 percent higher in Tokyo on launch day and Sensor Tower still estimated over 17 million copies and $1.65 billion as of Thursday morning.
body: As Stocktwits reports it, Sensor Tower estimated over 17 million copies sold worldwide and $1.65 billion in sales as of the morning of Thursday, November 19, with PlayStation about three quarters of sales. These are Sensor Tower estimates, not Take-Two figures.

Stocktwits reports Take-Two shares up 1 percent in pre-market trading on November 19 after a gain of over 6 percent the day before, Microsoft up 1.6 percent, Sony closing nearly 3 percent higher in Tokyo, and AMD up 3 percent before the market opened.

news.name: A second PlayStation Network outage as the US launch begins
news.summary: PlayStation Network had a second short disruption early on November 19, around the time the game unlocked in the eastern United States. Both outages are over, and Sony has not said what caused them.
body: TechRepublic reports two PSN disruptions, one on November 18 and one on November 19. It cites the outage monitor IsDown, which logged about 24 minutes of degraded Gaming and Social services, game streaming included, from 5:34 a.m. UTC on November 19, and a 32-minute disruption on November 18. TechRepublic adds that IsDown's monitored windows may not cover every player's connection trouble.

Digit gives an Indian-time timeline for the US launch. Reports on Downdetector rose from about 10:20 a.m. IST, the game unlocked in the US at 10:30 a.m. IST, and reports peaked at more than 8,900 around 10:40 a.m. IST. They were mostly from the United States and were about server connections, sign-in and downloads. Digit quotes PlayStation's status page as warning that players might have trouble launching games, apps or network features while a fix was worked on. 10:30 a.m. IST is midnight US Eastern time.

The reports do not agree. Neowin wrote that users reported several hours of problems that eased after about half an hour of rising reports, and that Sony's status site showed no issues when it looked. For the November 18 outage, TechRepublic cites CT Insider as counting more than 1,800 Downdetector complaints at one point. Downdetector numbers are reports sent in by users, not a count of affected accounts.

Sony has not said whether GTA VI traffic caused either outage. TechRepublic says a player who still cannot start the game while PSN is working may have a download, account or licence problem, and points to the Restore Licenses option under Settings > Users and Accounts > Other on PS5.

news.name: The Japanese release is toned down
news.summary: Kotaku reports that Japanese players found less nudity and blood in their copy of the game, and fewer languages. Rockstar had not confirmed any changes before release.
body: Kotaku says the Japanese version adds clothing to nudity throughout the game. Characters shower in underwear, some scenes are changed and others are removed. There is also less blood, and it fades sooner, judging by streams from Japanese creators. Strip clubs and in-game drug use are still in.
According to Kotaku, the Japanese version has only English and Japanese subtitles with the English voice track, and copies sold elsewhere do not include Japanese subtitles.

Before launch, players had noticed that the Japanese pre-load was over 1 GB smaller and that the rating from CERO, Japan's ratings board, did not mention the sexual content listed in most other countries. Kotaku says Rockstar confirmed no changes before release, so players only learned of the cuts once they started playing.
Kotaku also repeats that in Japan the download code in the boxed version must be redeemed within 170 days of release.

news.name: GameStop's chief executive criticises digital-only releases
news.summary: On launch day, GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen told Bloomberg that the move to all-digital games has hurt consumers and his company. GameStop still sells the boxed version, which holds a download code.
body: As Kotaku reports from the Bloomberg interview, Cohen said people should be able to sell, trade or lend games they buy. He did not name GTA VI.
He also told Bloomberg that the boxed edition is a code in a box and that GameStop is selling a lot of it. On November 17 he had posted on X asking who still wanted a physical copy of GTA.
Kotaku notes that pre-owned games and refurbished tech made up 22 percent of GameStop's revenue in the quarter ending August 1.

news.name: GTA VI takes over the PS5 Welcome hub
news.summary: Push Square reports that the PS5's Welcome hub now promotes the game and offers five new GTA VI wallpapers.
body: Push Square says the Welcome hub icon now has a pink and orange gradient with palm trees. A promotional panel at the top opens the game's PlayStation Store page and can be dismissed.
Further down the hub there is a new GTA VI backgrounds folder with five wallpapers in the game's illustrated style. Most show Jason and Lucia.
Push Square quotes no statement from Sony or Rockstar about it.

news.name: Take-Two's launch-day press release
news.summary: Take-Two and Rockstar issued a press release on November 19 announcing the game is out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, calling it the highest rated game of all time on those consoles.
body: The release went out on Business Wire from New York and is listed first on Take-Two's press-release page. Its subtitle says the game launches as the highest rated game of all time on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

It carries a new statement from Sam Houser, Rockstar's president and founder: in short, that the game represents everything Rockstar has worked towards since it began, that he hopes it goes beyond what players expect from the medium, and that Rockstar is grateful for the support. This is different wording from the statement he gave GamesRadar+ the day before.
It quotes short lines from reviews by The New York Times (a Critic's Pick), The Washington Post, Bloomberg, IGN, Eurogamer, The Guardian and Polygon.
It says Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, from Atlantic Records, has 34 original tracks and is out at midnight on streaming services, with vinyl and CD at gtavi-thealbum.com.
The game is listed as sold through the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store and retailers, and rated M by the ESRB.

The company background gives these Take-Two figures: Grand Theft Auto V has sold in nearly 235 million units, the series nearly 480 million, and Red Dead Redemption nearly 118 million. 'Sold in' means copies shipped to stores, not copies bought by players.

The release gives no sales or player numbers for Grand Theft Auto VI. IGN's live blog points out that the score is a joint record across all platforms: on Metacritic the game shares 99 with the Nintendo 64 Ocarina of Time.

news.name: Rockstar posts the full credits online
news.summary: Rockstar has put the game's complete credits on its website, searchable, with every department, the main cast, and a long list of former employees.
body: The page at rockstargames.com/VI/credits has sections for Writing, Audio, Game Design, Development Production, Performance Production, Animation, Technology, Art, Platform Services, Quality Assurance, Publishing, Cast, GTA Media, outsourced services, Street Art and Tattoos, and Special Thanks. A separate list is headed Former Employees.

It is headed by Sam Houser (Founder, Executive Producer), Jennifer Kolbe (Head of Publishing), Rob Nelson and Aaron Garbut (both Head of Development / Co-Studio Head), Phil Hooker (Head of Development) and Chris Choi (Senior Vice President of Development).

Other department heads named include Rupert Humphries (Senior Vice President of Narrative), Stephen Donkin (Vice President of Design), Jonathon Ashcroft (Senior Vice President of Technology), Alastair MacGregor (Vice President of Audio) and Jeff Rosa (Vice President of Quality Assurance).
The GTA TV and radio writing directors are DJ Pooh and Joey Henson, and the additional writers include "Weird Al" Yankovic.
The main cast list names Dylan Rourke as Jason Duval and Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos. Eurogamer says the credits went up on November 19; Rockstar's page shows no date.

news.name: Dylan Rourke is named as Jason
news.summary: Rockstar's published credits list Dylan Rourke as the actor playing Jason Duval, and a photo of him with Manni L. Perez appeared the same day.
body: Rockstar's credits page lists Dylan Rourke against Jason Duval at the top of the main cast, followed by Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos.

IGN reports that Lucia's main stunt double, Victoria Lee, posted a photo on Instagram on November 19 of herself with Rourke and Perez in front of a Grand Theft Auto VI billboard. IGN calls it the first public confirmation of Rourke in the role, and says his name had been going around online for the previous day.
IGN describes Rourke as an actor with guest roles in TV series including Modern Family and Grey's Anatomy.
The same cast list confirms Stephen Root as Brian Heder and names other actors, including Bobby Moynihan as Cal and Manny Perez as Raul Bautista.

news.name: All 34 fired Rockstar staff appear in the credits
news.summary: Eurogamer reports that all 34 Rockstar employees fired in 2025 are named in the game's credits, six of them under their old departments rather than as former employees.
body: Eurogamer checked a list of 34 names supplied by the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain, the union bringing the tribunal case. On November 18 it had matched at least 28; after Rockstar put the credits online in searchable form on November 19 it confirmed all 34.
Eurogamer says six of the names are not in the Former Employees list but under the departments those people worked in, as if they still worked at Rockstar. It does not know why and says it is asking.
Eurogamer did not publish the names, for privacy reasons.

The numbers disagree: Eurogamer, citing the union's list, says 34 were fired, while the Guardian piece by a Rockstar programmer that this app already cites gives 31 union members. Both are reported here.
Eurogamer also repeats Rockstar's earlier figure of more than 4,711 people across 12 offices working on the game.

news.name: IGN: about 20 million pre-orders likely by launch
news.summary: IGN works out from Sensor Tower's data that pre-orders probably reached about 20 million before release. That is an extrapolation, not a company figure.
body: IGN says Sensor Tower counted 17.07 million copies by November 16, with pre-orders then averaging more than a million a day, which makes 20 million a likely total by launch. Sensor Tower is not quoted giving 20 million itself.
The dates disagree: IGN dates Sensor Tower's 17.07 million to November 16, while GameSpot and Reuters, as this app already records, gave about 17 million as of November 18.
IGN puts Sensor Tower's revenue estimate above $1.6 billion, split about 75 percent PlayStation 5 and 25 percent Xbox Series X|S.

IGN describes Take-Two shares rising about 6 percent from a low of $203 on November 17 to a high of $222 at the close on November 18. Fox Business, as already recorded, gave the November 18 close as $216.61; the figures do not match.
Rockstar and Take-Two had published no pre-order or sales numbers when IGN wrote, and the launch press release gives none either.

news.name: Xbox puts the game's artwork on every dashboard
news.summary: Xbox consoles replaced players' own backgrounds with GTA VI artwork through a feature called Event Backgrounds, which can be switched off. Microsoft is now asking for feedback on it.
body: IGN reports that the feature, which is on by default, shows artwork of Jason and Lucia in place of the player's chosen theme. It says Microsoft did the same with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 the month before.
To switch it off, IGN gives Settings, Personalisation, My Background, then untick Show Event-themed Background. One player quoted by IGN said the option had turned itself back on.
IGN says a new Xbox Feedback poll asks players what they think of Event Backgrounds and how often they should be used.

Eurogamer notes that Xbox's own launch-week posts, such as How to Get Ready for November 19, never name the game. Its guess is that PlayStation's marketing deal with Rockstar stops other consoles using the name in advertising. That is Eurogamer's reading, not a confirmed term. Xbox Wire does name the game in factual posts, such as the one on cloud streaming.

news.name: Restaurant chains mark launch day
news.summary: Popeyes, KFC, Subway and Burger King ran launch-week food promotions themed on the game. The reports describe the KFC and Burger King ones as unofficial.
body: Popeyes (US): a limited Spice City Sandwich, two chicken fillets on a brioche bun, sold November 19 to 22 in restaurants, in the app and for delivery, according to Nation's Restaurant News. The report does not say whether Rockstar is involved.

KFC (UK): Dexerto reports a London competition in which winners got meals delivered on November 19 by a pink 1959 Cadillac branded Cluck n' Bell, a nod to the series' Cluckin' Bell. Dexerto says it is not an official Rockstar collaboration. It also reports free UK delivery through Just Eat from 6 p.m. on November 19, subject to confirmation, and a mock funeral with free chicken at KFC in Robina, Queensland, the same day.

Subway (Miami only): the Cubano Pulled Pork Melt renamed the Vice City Cubano, as Dexerto reports. Dexerto credits the image to Subway and Rockstar Games but does not say whether Rockstar approved it.

Burger King (Belgium): a seven-patty HeartWhopper, a real version of the series' Heart Stopper burger from Burger Shot. IGN says it is not sold on the menu. It is a prize in a two-week social-media competition, and IGN's live blog calls it a parody rather than an official collaboration.
This is separate from KFC Spain's disc-shaped chicken and the Skinny Louie Burger Shot restaurants, which the reports mention as other promotions.

news.name: Rockstar's launch-day Newswire post
news.summary: Rockstar's Newswire announced the game is out worldwide on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and said November 19 is the last day to get the early-purchase bonuses.
body: The post says November 19 is the final day on which buying the game includes the Vintage Vice City Pack and a free month of GTA+, and that GTA+ now includes bonuses for Grand Theft Auto VI.

It points to the official site for trailers, screenshots and artwork, including a printable cover-art poster and map of Leonida, and says a double-sided printed version of that poster will go on sale at the Rockstar Store shortly after launch.

It also mentions IGN's Official Grand Theft Auto VI Guide, launching the same day with walkthroughs of the first two chapters and an interactive map, and says Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, with 34 original tracks, is out at midnight Eastern on streaming services and on vinyl or CD.
Rockstar asks players not to share story spoilers openly.

news.name: Rockstar's audio desync advice
news.summary: Rockstar Support published articles on November 19 about sound falling out of sync on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It suggests the usual cause is the TV or audio setup.
body: Both articles suggest first testing whether the fault is in the game: plug headphones into the controller, or record a clip with the console's capture feature and play it back on a different device. If either sounds right, Rockstar says the TV or audio hardware is causing the problem.
For that case Rockstar suggests turning on the TV's Game Mode.

The console setting it gives differs by platform. On PS5 it says to turn Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) off, under Settings, Screen and Video, Video Output. On Xbox it says to tick Allow Auto Low-Latency Mode, under Profile & System, Settings, General, TV & Display Options, Video Modes.
The articles say they apply to Rockstar games in general, not only Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar has not called this a bug in the game.

news.name: Where to find pre-order bonuses
news.summary: A Rockstar Support FAQ from launch day says pre-order bonuses are in the Pause Menu under Store, where each one explains how to claim it.
body: The FAQ points to rockstargames.com/VI/editions for the list of bonuses.

For the free month of GTA+, it links an earlier article (last updated June 24). That article says digital purchases made before November 20 qualify. On PlayStation the month must be claimed from the GTA+ page on PlayStation Store by March 31, 2027. On Xbox it must be claimed within 180 days of purchase, under Offers & Credits in the Microsoft Store.

The same article says the offer is limited to one claim per platform account, a refund and second pre-order does not earn another month, and existing members get the month added to their current subscription. The membership renews at the normal monthly price unless cancelled.

news.name: Rockstar lists the GTA+ benefits
news.summary: Rockstar's site now has a GTA+ page for Grand Theft Auto VI listing four optional perks for members on console.
body: The page lists: the '90 Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy, a widebody sports car, with a garage in the Crosstown District, claimable from Chapter 3; 10 percent more money when selling owned vehicles; transit bonuses, which it says include Scooter Bros Premium vehicle care, premium RydeMe rideshare membership, free scooter and bike rentals and Leonida metro benefits; and a 10 percent discount at selected businesses such as weapons and clothes shops, hairdressers, tattooists and vehicle mod shops.
Rockstar says an active membership and an internet connection are needed to claim the benefits, and that the subscription is sold through the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store and renews monthly.
The page shows no date. Rockstar's Newswire post of November 19 says GTA+ now contains Grand Theft Auto VI bonuses.

news.name: Sensor Tower: 19 million copies
news.summary: GameSpot and Reuters report that Sensor Tower's tracker now estimates about 19 million copies sold and $1.84 billion in gross revenue. This is an outside estimate, not a Take-Two figure.
body: GameSpot, writing at 5:06 a.m. Pacific on November 19, gives Sensor Tower's count as 19.05 million copies from pre-purchases: 14.23 million on PS5 ($1.38 billion) and 4.82 million on Xbox Series X|S ($464 million), roughly a 75 to 25 split.

Reuters gives Sensor Tower's figure as 19.1 million units as of Thursday morning, worth about $1.84 billion. Reuters also gives its own estimate that first-day sales were close to $2 billion, compared with about $800 million for Grand Theft Auto V's first day in 2013.
The figures disagree with an earlier estimate: Stocktwits, already recorded in this app, reported Sensor Tower at over 17 million copies and $1.65 billion on the same morning.
Sensor Tower had projected up to 25 million pre-purchases by launch. GameSpot says that projection was about 6 million too high.

Reuters says Take-Two shares fell about 1 percent on Thursday after rising 6 percent the day before. It says Take-Two has given no sales figures and has called demand unprecedented. It quotes chief executive Strauss Zelnick saying earlier in the month that the company avoids claiming success before it happens.

news.name: Streams Charts' first-day count
news.summary: Streams Charts' first-day recap puts the peak at 7,915,475 people watching at once and 125.47 million hours watched in the first 24 hours.
body: Streams Charts gives these peaks by platform: Twitch 3,313,371, YouTube 3,216,408, Kick 1,498,752, SOOP Korea 122,964 and CHZZK 86,231.
It says the peak is more than four and a half times the previous launch record, Valorant's 1.74 million. It calls the game the most watched ever on Twitch and on Kick, and second on YouTube.

By hours watched, the top streamers it lists are IShowSpeed (4.47 million), TheBurntPeanut (3.89 million) and alanzoka (3.11 million). The biggest single-channel peak it lists is IlloJuan's, at about 562,000.
This revises the preliminary 7,886,176 peak already in the app. The recap does not mention the earlier figure.
Separately, NBC News reported Twitch saying 1.9 million people were watching streams of the game mid-morning Eastern time.

news.name: Jason's and Lucia's actors speak
news.summary: VGC reports that Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez posted a joint Instagram statement on November 19, the first time either has spoken about their roles.
body: As VGC reports it, the pair said they were honoured to have worked on the game, praised the skill of the people who made it, and signed off by saying they would see players in Leonida.
VGC says Grand Theft Auto VI appears to be Rourke's first video game role, and that Rockstar kept both actors' names quiet until the game was out in every region.

news.name: Why there is no theme park
news.summary: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson told VGC that the game has no Disney World-style park because building a working one would take a lot of work and the story had no strong reason to go there.
body: Nelson told VGC that the team builds what the story and the feel of Leonida need. When asked whether players would expect many working rides, he said the hard part is knowing where to stop, and that interiors have to be filled so they feel natural.
VGC notes that the original Vice City parodied Disney World in adverts for Fun World. The comments come from an upcoming VGC interview, the same one in which Nelson explained why darts was left out.

news.name: CD Projekt Red congratulates Rockstar
news.summary: GamesRadar+ reports that CD Projekt Red joint chief executive Michał Nowakowski called the game a masterpiece in a post on X and congratulated the team.
body: As GamesRadar+ reports it, Nowakowski said he plans to explore the game over the coming weeks and months, and that what the team achieved is extremely hard to do. The official Cyberpunk 2077 account also posted congratulations.
GamesRadar+ also quotes Cyberpunk 2 associate game director Paweł Sasko and The Witcher 4 director Sebastian Kalemba praising the launch.

news.name: Heat's Vice City merchandise sales
news.summary: The Miami Heat told NBC News they sold $1.5 million of Vice City merchandise at the launch-eve game against the Bucks.
body: A Heat spokesman told NBC News that Vice City jerseys had sold out by halftime.

Kotaku, already cited in this app, reported that all the gear sold out in about 90 minutes. The NBA reporter Tim Reynolds had predicted a record for merchandise sold at one game; NBC's figure does not say whether it is a record.

The same NBC live blog says Miami-Dade County accepted a $3.9 million advertising package from Rockstar, and quotes Mayor Daniella Levine Cava's October statement that it lets the county earn extra money from the attention. NBC also notes that the US Department of the Interior posted on X that it was busy birdwatching in the game.

news.name: Launch-day grumbles over when Ultimate Edition extras unlock
news.summary: Game Rant and VGTimes report fans complaining that many of the $99.99 Ultimate Edition's extras only become usable after hours of story progress. Rockstar has not confirmed the reported unlock times.
body: Game Rant, citing the X account Pirat_Nation, says most of the edition's content opens up by Chapter 2 and some not until Chapter 5. VGTimes, citing PlayStation LifeStyle, says Chapter 2 could be more than 25 hours in and puts the 1995 Grotti Cheetah in Chapter 5, possibly close to 60 hours in.

The two reports describe the first-chapter items differently. VGTimes lists Jason's Dinka Enduro, the Crest Kayak and a modified Vapid Ganado as unlocking in Chapter 1, while Game Rant says those three can only be used during Chapter 1 and then become unavailable.
Some players compared the schedule to a paid battle pass. Others defended it as keeping the sense of progression, both outlets report.
Neither outlet reports any response from Rockstar, and both say the later unlock points are estimates rather than confirmed figures.

news.name: Deus Ex creator Warren Spector hopes it is "the last of its kind"
news.summary: On LinkedIn, the veteran designer Warren Spector congratulated the team and called the game a high point for the medium. He also argued that a game this expensive is not a model the industry should follow.
body: Spector said a budget around a billion dollars could instead pay for many games and many salaries, at a time when thousands of developers are out of work. VGTimes reports that he cited development estimates of $1 billion to $2 billion, not counting marketing. These are his estimates, not figures from Take-Two.

He also wrote that important games rarely ship on time or on budget, pointing out that this one arrived at least a year after its original date. He added that games need enough time and money to succeed.
Kotaku's launch live blog also picked up the post.

news.name: Doja Cat says she is "bitter" her music is not in the game
news.summary: In a series of X posts on launch day, Doja Cat said she would have loved her music on the game's radio and aimed crude remarks at Rockstar, while saying she still loves the game.
body: Kotaku and Complex report that she tagged Rockstar's account directly and said the studio had broken her heart.
None of her songs are on the in-game radio, Kotaku says. It adds that Rockstar could still add music in a later update, but it has not said it will.
Complex notes that she had already name-checked the game in her song "All Mine" from her 2025 album Vie. Neither outlet reports a reply from Rockstar.

news.name: Players report losing progress after crashes and power-offs
news.summary: Kotaku and Notebookcheck report players losing hours of progress after crashes or switching consoles off, and warn that the autosave runs less often than many expect. Rockstar has not commented.
body: In Kotaku's testing, the autosave runs after main missions and larger side missions, but not after small optional jobs and never during a mission. Kotaku recommends pausing, saving manually and then quitting.
Notebookcheck reports crashes on both PS5 and Xbox Series X. It also notes that autosaves do not show up in the Save Game menu and have to be loaded from the separate Load Game screen.

The two outlets give different figures for the best-known case. Notebookcheck says the streamer JasonTheWeen lost 10 hours, citing an X post, while Kotaku says 11 hours, citing IGN. Both say it is unclear what happened, and Notebookcheck notes that some viewers think it was staged.
Kotaku also mentions one player who says stash cash and a collectible card disappeared after a manual save, which may be a bug.

Neither outlet reports a Rockstar statement or fix. Rockstar's Support site had no known-issues article for the game, and its service status page had no Grand Theft Auto VI entry, when read at about 10:30 a.m. Pacific.

news.name: Reuters: a big boost for Sony, but analysts expect less in Japan
news.summary: Reuters reports Sony shares rose almost 3 percent in Tokyo on launch day while the market was flat. Analysts quoted by Reuters expect the game to sell well in Japan, but not as a mega blockbuster.
body: Reuters cites Sensor Tower's estimate of 17 million copies, about three-quarters of them on PlayStation. That is an outside estimate, not a Take-Two figure.

Bernstein analyst David Dai wrote that his firm models PlayStation profits well above market expectations for the next couple of quarters because of the launch. Reuters says Bernstein forecasts 825 billion yen of operating profit for Sony's games unit this financial year, against Sony's own forecast of 800 billion yen.

Hideki Yasuda of Toyo Securities said current Japanese tastes do not really suit this kind of game. Serkan Toto of Kantan Games said satire and Western references may not land with Japanese players, but predicted it will still do very well there.

Reuters notes that Sony shipped 2.6 million PS5s in July to September, down from 4 million a year earlier, which analysts link to buyers waiting for the game. It also reports a large poster of Jason and Lucia on a building in Tokyo's Akihabara district.
investingLive reports the same share move and figures, attributing the Japan angle to Reuters.

news.name: Rockstar on why it hides Bigfoot and UFO mysteries in its worlds
news.summary: Rockstar North head of production Rob Nelson told Kotaku the team includes oddities like Bigfoot and UFOs simply because "we love that stuff", and now has the team size to build them.
body: Nelson said Florida's strange reputation is a big part of the appeal. He added that the team likes playing with players' expectations, so that it is unclear whether a sighting is real or staged.
He said the aim was for the countryside to have as much to find as the cities, so the wilds always feel as if something odd could be out there.
He credited a long-standing team in which smaller groups can now focus on fine details, as earlier games did with ghosts in Grand Theft Auto V and a vampire in Red Dead Redemption 2.

news.name: Ampere: about 2 million US and UK Xbox players went 'to New Zealand' to play early
news.summary: Eurogamer and IGN report Ampere Analysis's estimate that about 1.5 million US and 600,000 UK Xbox users switched their console region to New Zealand, where the game unlocked first, to start playing on November 18.
body: Because the game unlocked at midnight local time everywhere, New Zealand got it first. On Xbox, changing the console's country is a settings change; on PlayStation it needs a separate regional account and payment in local currency, which both outlets say made the trick harder there.

Eurogamer gives Ampere's other figures as 200,000 Xbox players in Canada, 200,000 in Brazil and 100,000 in Mexico, against only about 100,000 PlayStation players in the US. It quotes Ampere crediting the ease of switching country in Xbox account settings.
IGN says the practice is technically against the consoles' terms of service but that neither Microsoft nor Sony has moved to stop it, and that it had asked both for comment.

New Zealand's official tourism account, PureNewZealand, joined in on Instagram the day before, telling players it had heard some were trying the New Zealand trick and that it would love to have them, as Eurogamer reports.
These are Ampere's estimates, not figures from Microsoft, Sony or Rockstar.

news.name: Downing Street calls Rockstar 'a British success story'
news.summary: A spokesperson for UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham praised Rockstar as a British success story made in Edinburgh, but said the Prime Minister would not be playing the game.
body: IGN, citing The Independent, quotes a No 10 spokesperson saying Rockstar Games is a British success story made in Edinburgh and that many fans already think the game was worth the wait. Asked whether the Prime Minister would play it, the spokesperson said his diary was very full and that he would not.
The spokesperson also said nobody should take a 'GTA sickie' and that young fans should be in school, IGN reports.
IGN notes that the game was led by Rockstar North in Edinburgh with other Rockstar studios around the world contributing.
This item rests on IGN's report of The Independent's account; The Independent's article itself was not read.

news.name: Newzoo's launch-week forecast: $3.25 to $5.2 billion
news.summary: On launch day, Gearbox's Randy Pitchford brought back Newzoo's July forecast that the game could take $3.25 billion to $5.2 billion in its launch week, roughly 37 to 51 million copies. That is a forecast, not a sales figure.
body: VGC reported Newzoo's analysis in July 2026. Newzoo estimated about $180 million in digital pre-order spending across the US and Europe's five biggest markets in the last week of June. Using Grand Theft Auto V's player spread, it put the global total at about $260 million and called it the strongest pre-order campaign ever recorded.

From that, Newzoo projected about $4.5 billion, or roughly 51 million copies, by the end of launch week. If pre-orders were unusually front-loaded, it projected about $3.3 billion, or roughly 37 million copies. The range Newzoo quotes is $3.25 billion to $5.2 billion. Newzoo also called social media claims of a billion dollars in pre-orders 21 weeks out absurd.

GamesRadar+ reports that Pitchford posted that, by Newzoo's forecast, the game would earn more in its launch week than the original theatrical runs of the most successful Harry Potter, Lord of the Rings and Star Wars films combined. GamesRadar+ works that total out from Box Office Mojo at about $4.53 billion.

GamesRadar+ gives the low end as $3.3 billion; Newzoo's own quoted range starts at $3.25 billion. GamesRadar+ also notes that Sensor Tower's then-latest estimate, 17.07 million copies and $1.65 billion, was below that total, while Newzoo's forecast covers the full week.
Take-Two and Rockstar had not published any sales figures when these pages were read.

news.name: Peter Moore and Larian's Michael Douse on what the launch means for games
news.summary: Former Xbox and EA executive Peter Moore said the industry could use a moment like this launch after years of closures and layoffs. Larian's publishing lead Michael Douse called it a rare cultural moment.
body: GamesRadar+ reports that Moore, a former Sega of America president, Microsoft Xbox executive and EA chief executive, wrote on X that the industry had been through a hard stretch of studio closures, redundancies and cancelled projects. He said that is why the launch feels significant, and hoped it gives the whole industry a much-needed shot in the arm.
Moore also posted an AI-edited picture of himself with a Grand Theft Auto VI tattoo in place of the GTA IV tattoo he showed at E3 2006, GamesRadar+ says.

Replying to Warren Spector's hope that the game is 'the last of its kind', Larian Studios' publishing lead Michael Douse wrote on X that it is nice for every audience and generation to share a cultural moment around something that turned out genuinely brilliant. He added that not every game needs to be GTA, which leaves room for other kinds of games, GamesRadar+ reports.

news.name: Internet exchange DE-CIX reports traffic records around GTA VI
news.summary: DE-CIX says its exchanges hit a new worldwide peak of 33.03 Tbit/s on launch eve, after a 33.01 Tbit/s record during the pre-load week.
body: Variety reports that internet exchange operator DE-CIX measured a record 33.03 terabits per second across its exchanges worldwide at 20:20 CET on Wednesday, November 18, as the game began unlocking around the world.

DE-CIX told Variety that traffic during the launch window was 25 percent higher than in a typical week at the start of the year, and listed above-average peaks in New York (2.44 Tbit/s), Frankfurt (22.15 Tbit/s), Madrid (1.43 Tbit/s), Dubai (1.25 Tbit/s) and Chicago (1.22 Tbit/s).
A week earlier, IT Brief reported a previous DE-CIX record of 33.01 Tbit/s as pre-downloads began on November 10, the first time its global traffic passed 33 Tbit/s, with Frankfurt at 22.30 Tbit/s.
DE-CIX does not say how much of this traffic was the game itself.
Disagreement: IT Brief describes the download as more than 200 GB; check against the app's own file-size figure.

news.name: Take-Two shares slip on launch day after the previous day's jump
news.summary: Reuters says Take-Two shares fell about 1% on Thursday after rising 6% the day before, while the company still gave no sales figures.
body: Reuters reports Take-Two's shares were down about 1 percent on launch day, Thursday, November 19, after a 6 percent rise in the previous session.

Reuters says Take-Two has described demand as unprecedented and far beyond expectations without giving a number, and quotes Strauss Zelnick from this month's earnings call that the company avoids claiming success before it happens.

Reuters cites estimates that the game cost Take-Two $1 billion or more to make, and quotes TD Cowen analyst Doug Creutz that the timing and size of the next GTA Online matter more to the stock than the game's unit sales.
Reuters says some analysts expect a PC version and the online mode in 2027; Rockstar has not announced either date.

news.name: PC Gamer fact-checks two viral claims about toned-down violence
news.summary: PC Gamer says the claims about a gay nightclub and planes bouncing off buildings are misleading: no such club exists, and the planes clip uses a damage setting.
body: PC Gamer (1:24 p.m. PT) looked at two claims spreading on social media as supposed proof that Rockstar softened the violence: that the game stops players shooting inside a gay nightclub, and that planes bounce off buildings to avoid 9/11 imagery.

It says guns cannot be used inside the game's clubs, such as Nine1Nine and The Vault, as in Grand Theft Auto V, but that none of the clubs is presented as a gay or LGBTQ venue. Rockstar has not explained the rule.

It says the clips of planes hitting towers unharmed are real but made with the Reduced Vehicle Damage gameplay setting, which the menu warns changes the balance of play; with the setting off, a plane that hits a building explodes, though the building is not damaged.

news.name: Police departments and politicians post about the launch
news.summary: Newsweek rounds up police departments borrowing the game's style for safety messages, plus posts from Florida Senator Ashley Moody and the White House.
body: Newsweek reports that several US police forces used the launch for public-safety posts: Atlanta police told followers that GTA is not a real place but Atlanta is, Aurora police in Colorado said they have no six-star system and one star is enough, and San Juan police in Texas made a video ending on the game-style Busted screen.

It says Greensboro police in North Carolina hoped the game would keep people at home, a post viewed about a million times, and South Fulton police in Georgia reminded people there is no respawn in real life.

Newsweek says Florida Senator Ashley Moody wrote on X that crime might pay in Leonida but not in Florida, and that the White House's X account posted a short montage of President Trump in the game's visual style.
It also reports that on Fox News' Outnumbered a retired NYPD inspector compared giving the game to a child with handing over a gun; Newsweek notes the game is rated M for 17 and older.

news.name: Fired Rockstar North staff describe a 'bittersweet' launch day
news.summary: CNET spoke to three of the staff Rockstar fired in October 2025 about launch day, hours after the Glasgow tribunal heard Rockstar's closing submissions.
body: CNET (November 19, 4:41 p.m. ET) interviewed three former Rockstar North employees, lighting artist Branimira Yordanova, senior production coordinator Dayne Oram and open-world designer Jacob Jones, all part of the union case over the 2025 dismissals.

Yordanova told CNET she is avoiding the game for now, Oram said they would watch streams rather than play, and Jones said he started playing at 1 a.m. after returning from the tribunal and called it a masterpiece.

CNET says none of the three has found new work in the 13 months since, that the workers are awaiting the tribunal's verdict, and that Rockstar North maintains the dismissals were for gross misconduct and did not respond to a request for comment.
CNET puts the number dismissed in the UK and Canada at 34, with 23 former Rockstar North staff in the IWGB's case.

news.name: The Guardian's games editor urges parents not to buy the game for children
news.summary: Keza MacDonald calls GTA VI the most explicit game she has played and says it has thoroughly earned its 18 rating, in a launch-day piece aimed at parents.
body: In a Guardian piece published on launch day, Keza MacDonald, who says she played for more than 70 hours, praises the game but writes that it has more sexual content than any previous GTA game, including full-frontal nudity, alongside drug use and graphic violence.
She notes the in-game TV, radio and pedestrian chatter also carry adult humour, and suggests that a child too young for Breaking Bad is too young for the game.
MacDonald says she is not trying to start a moral panic: the content is fair game for adults, but parents should make informed decisions, noting the game's 18 rating.

news.name: Rob Nelson: the opening was kept short after Red Dead Redemption 2
